purpose: Design rules for Markdown parsing, DLID reading and writing, heading anchors, content hash computation, and AI-generated field limits and validation.
summary: Frontmatter detection and doc_link_id recognition; missing or invalid values all count as no document ID
DLID format: 60-bit random value in lowercase Crockford Base32, 12 characters, case-sensitive match
Writes are limited to DLIDs at frontmatter and heading ends, verified by re-parsing and rolled back on other diffs
Atomic replacement via temp file and os.replace, preserving permissions and following symlinks
Parsing uses markdown-it-py and CommonMark link rules for reference definitions, labels, titles, hrefs and fragments
Heading anchors follow github-slugger-compatible rules with character removal and duplicate numbering
Content hash is SHA-256 of raw UTF-8 bytes, excluding the title of formal references; title records use the first 12 characters
Section hash covers the section range from its heading to the next heading of equal or higher level
AI-generated fields use limits L with a hidden validator bound H and minimum element counts; values are written in English
tasks: Implementing Markdown parsing and reference extraction
Implementing DLID assignment and write verification
Computing or testing content hashes and test vectors
Generating heading anchors for fragment checks
Implementing validation of AI-generated ToC fields
Reviewing writes to user documents for boundary compliance
title: DES-008 Markdown 解析・比較値・生成情報の規則
